en.title: Microsoft Edge: CVE-2025-12428 Type Confusion in V8
en.summary: Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) is affected by a critical vulnerability, CVE-2025-12428, involving type confusion in V8.
en.impact: The vulnerability involves type confusion in V8, carrying a CVSS score of 9.8.

checks: Check systems for Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) installations.
